score_notes.E: Good tables (L93-98, L155-160, L194-197, L573-580, L636-641, L713-718) and text diagrams (L27-39, L120-131, L262-271, L657-668). score_notes.F: All 15 sampled claims supported. Outside the sample: L603 'proxy_location: EveryNode는 노드마다 프록시를 하나씩 띄우므로' drops the docs' scope 'every node ... that has at least one replica actor' (stated correctly at L575); L114 vs L575 contradiction mirrors an inconsistency between the architecture and config docs pages; illustrative client/handler code at L322-333 and L407-412 does not match each other (labelled illustrative at L320, so not counted as invented API).
score_notes.T1: Real commands/flags (serve run, -r/--reload, serve build -o, serve status, config keys, env vars) and the official TF/sklearn/PyTorch patterns are present, but the running example cannot actually run end to end: Translator lacks translate (L64-72 vs L331), payload shape mismatch (L411 vs L329), self.summarize undefined, no model loading.
score_notes.T2: Covers the important doc topics in a sensible order (concepts -> architecture -> routing -> composition -> local run -> HTTP -> config -> autoscaling -> K8s/fault tolerance -> metrics -> when to choose). Direct streaming (L250-300, experimental LLM feature) and the KubeRay annotation workaround from a forum thread (L734-744) are somewhat beyond the core of the seed page but are sourced and flagged.
score_notes.T3: Strong internals: controller/proxy/replica roles, request lifetime with 100KiB object-store boundary, handle data path, router plug-in patterns and trade-offs, two-tier Serve/Ray autoscaling and scale-down packing, failure matrix with GCS checkpointing, metrics path. Design advice is marked as the guide's own ('이 가이드의 판단으로는', L241, L300, L672). Installation does not dominate.
